an6.18:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Kosalesu cārikaṃ carati mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ.
an6.18:1.2: Addasā kho Bhagavā addhānamaggapaṭipanno aññatarasmiṃ padese macchikaṃ macchabandhaṃ macche vadhitvā vadhitvā vikkiṇamāṇaṃ,
an6.18:1.3: disvā maggā ukkamma aññatarasmiṃ rukkhamūle paññatte āsane nisīdi.
an6.18:1.5: Passatha no tumhe bhikkhave amuṃ macchikaṃ macchabandhaṃ macche vadhitvā vadhitvā vikkiṇamānan ti?
an6.18:2.2: api nu tumhehi diṭṭhaṃ vā sutaṃ vā:
an6.18:2.3: macchiko macchabandho macche vadhitvā vadhitvā vikkiṇamāno tena kammena tena ājīvena hatthiyāyī vā assayāyī vā rathayāyī vā yānayāyī vā bhogabhogī vā mahantaṃ vā bhogakkhandhaṃ ajjhāvasanto ti?
an6.18:2.6: mayā pi kho etaṃ bhikkhave neva diṭṭhaṃ na sutaṃ:
an6.18:2.7: macchiko macchabandho macche vadhitvā vadhitvā vikkiṇamāno tena kammena tena ājīvena hatthiyāyī vā assayāyī va rathayāyī vā yānayāyī vā bhogabhogī vā mahantaṃ vā bhogakkhandhaṃ ajjhāvasanto ti.
an6.18:2.9: Te hi so bhikkhave macche vajjhe vadhāy' upanīte pāpakena manasānupekkhati, tasmā so neva hatthiyāyī hoti na assayāyī na rathayāyī na yānayāyī na bhogabhogī, na mahantaṃ bhogakkhandhaṃ ajjhāvasati.
an6.18:3.2: api nu tumhehi diṭṭhaṃ vā sutaṃ vā:
an6.18:3.3: goghātako gāvo vadhitvā vadhitvā vikkiṇamāno tena kammena tena ājīvena hatthiyāyī vā assayāyī vā rathayāyī vā yānayāyī vā bhogabhogī vā mahantaṃ vā bhogakkhandhaṃ ajjhāvasanto ti?
an6.18:3.6: mayā pi kho etaṃ bhikkhave neva diṭṭhaṃ na sutaṃ:
an6.18:3.7: goghātako gāvo vadhitvā vadhitvā vikkiṇamāno tena kammena tena ājīvena hatthiyāyī vā assayāyī vā rathayāyī vā yānayāyī vā bhogabhogī vā mahantaṃ vā bhogakkhandhaṃ ajjhāvasanto ti.
an6.18:3.9: Te hi so bhikkhave gāvo vajjhe vadhāy' upanīte pāpakena manasānupekkhati, tasmā so neva hatthiyāyī hoti na assayāyī na rathayāyī na yānayāyī na bhogabhogī, na mahantaṃ bhogakkhandhaṃ ajjhāvasati.
an6.18:4.2: api nu tumhehi diṭṭhaṃ vā sutaṃ vā:
an6.18:4.6: māgaviko mige vadhitvā vadhitvā vikkiṇamāno tena kammena tena ājīvena hatthiyāyī vā assayāyī vā rathayāyī vā yānayāyī vā bhogabhogī vā mahantaṃ vā bhogakkhandhaṃ ajjhāvasanto ti?
an6.18:4.9: mayā pi kho etaṃ bhikkhave neva diṭṭhaṃ na sutaṃ:
an6.18:4.10: māgaviko mige vadhitvā vadhitvā vikkiṇamāno tena kammena tena ājīvena hatthiyāyī vā assayāyī vā rathayāyī vā yānayāyī vā bhogabhogī vā mahantaṃ vā bhogakkhandhaṃ ajjhāvasanto ti.
an6.18:4.12: Te hi so bhikkhave mige vajjhe vadhāy' upanīte pāpakena manasānupekkhati, tasmā so neva hatthiyāyī hoti na assayāyī na rathayāyī na yānayāyī na bhogabhogī, na mahantaṃ bhogakkhandhaṃ ajjhāvasati.
an6.18:4.13: Te hi so bhikkhave tiracchānagate pāṇe vajjhe vadhāy' upanīte pāpakena manasānupekkhamāno neva hatthiyāyī bhavissati na assayāyī na rathayāyī na yānayāyī na bhogabhogī, na mahantaṃ bhogakkhandhaṃ ajjhāvasissati.
an6.18:4.14: Ko pana vādo yaṃ manussabhūtaṃ vajjhaṃ vadhāy' upanītaṃ pāpakena manasānupekkhati,
an6.18:4.15: taṃ hi 'ssa bhikkhave hoti dīgharattaṃ ahitāya dukkhāya,
an6.18:4.16: kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjatī
